# Native build dependencies for comma 3 (tici) on AGNOS 12.6.
#
# 0.11.2 gets these from comma-deps-* wheels installed into the device venv.
# AGNOS 12.6 predates that, so we install them repo-locally with
# `pip install --target c3_third_party` and put that dir first on PYTHONPATH
# (see launch_chffrplus.sh). SConstruct imports each by bare module name and
# reads INCLUDE_DIR / LIB_DIR from it, so real wheels work unmodified.
#
# Versions are pinned to what uv.lock resolves, NOT left to float. The post
# numbers are not cosmetic: comma-deps-raylib 6.0.0.1.post103 ships no raygui
# bindings, so the UI dies on rl.GuiTextAlignment, while the pinned post93 has
# all 78 Gui* symbols. Re-sync these pins from uv.lock when rebasing onto a
# newer naponsp-alpha.
#
# Must cover every entry in SConstruct's pkg_names.
comma-deps-acados==0.2.2.post95
comma-deps-bzip2==1.0.8.post95
comma-deps-capnproto==1.0.1.post93
comma-deps-catch2==2.13.10.post93
comma-deps-eigen==3.4.0.post93
comma-deps-ffmpeg==7.1.0.post94
comma-deps-json11==20170411.0.post93
comma-deps-ncurses==6.5.post93
comma-deps-zeromq==4.3.5.post93
comma-deps-zstd==1.5.6.post93

# raylib 6.0 plus its pyray binding. AGNOS 12.6's venv has raylib-python-cffi
# 5.5.0.2, whose LoadFontData takes 6 args; 0.11.2 calls it with 7.
comma-deps-raylib==6.0.0.1.post93

# USB panda support on C3 (see selfdrive/pandad, C3_USB_FIRST)
comma-deps-libusb==1.0.29.post93

# dbus, imported by the runtime
jeepney==0.9.0
